title: Preserve bytes elements when coercing mixed-type arrays for hashing
answers: Why does hash_pandas_object raise UnicodeDecodeError on mixed types with bytes?
How to hash mixed object arrays containing non-ASCII bytes in hash_array?
UnicodeDecodeError when hashing Series with both string and byte elements
body:
Symptom: hash_pandas_object and hash_array raise UnicodeDecodeError when hashing mixed-type object arrays containing non-ASCII bytes.
Root cause: pandas/core/util/hashing.py:_hash_ndarray catches TypeError and falls back to vals.astype(str), causing numpy to decode bytes elements as ASCII.
Fix pattern: Leave bytes elements as-is using boolean indexing and only convert non-bytes elements to strings before retrying hash_object_array.
Constraints: Applies to mixed-type object arrays during fallback hashing; does not apply to homogeneous arrays where hash_object_array succeeds directly.
applies: Hashing mixed-type object arrays containing bytes in pandas.core.util.hashing.
